name: Shrubify
subtitle: Made by shrubbery & the ShrubHub team
description: A community fork of EeveeSpotify Reincarnated. Liquid Glass settings on iOS 26, with Spotify’s original colors preserved. Unofficial, not affiliated with Spotify.

apps.name: Shrubify
apps.subtitle: Listening is easy with Shrubify!
apps.localizedDescription: Shrubify 3.0 adds Studio with saved player layouts, a quick-access ShrubPanel, opt-in local Replay and ShrubQueue bookmarks and snapshots. Source credits and GPL notices are in the repository.

versions.localizedDescription: Shrubify v3.0.6 for Spotify 9.1.94. Studio presets, ShrubPanel, opt-in Replay, queue shortcuts and supported Liquid Glass. Compatibility depends on Spotify version.
